additional_info.subject: Case Issue
additional_info.body:
It is already not the first time that plug 1 of the 170001392 goes offline and stays offline after reboot. Rebooted today at 3:16 pm, please look at the logs from this time.
The last time I created a ticket for this I got the response that the loader is fully online with no errors. Which is good, but now I would still like this issue to be investigated further so we can figure out the cause and if necessary, replace the necessary pieces.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421333-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R1 170001392] Charger Is Offline CRM:02699000057
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic/Team,
We have analyzed the logs and found that Outlet1 has been unavailable multiple times due to an IMD_BC1 issue. This appears to be caused by interrupted Modbus connection, as no new data from IMD was received within 5 seconds via Modbus. Attaching the logs for your reference.
We need to arrange a site intervention to:
Check the wiring
Inspect the IMD component
Verify all respective connections related to IMD.
Please bring:
One spare IMD
Multiple ethernet cables
This will ensure we can perform any necessary replacements during the same visit. Please find the MLFB reference below.
8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1 : Insulation Monitoring Device
